fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects Obfuscated use of Environment Variables to execute PowerShell
fields.name: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR+ Launcher
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and tgt.process.cmdline matches "cmd.{0,5}(?:/c|/r)(?:\\s|)\\"set\\s[a-zA-Z]{3,6}.*(?:\\{\\d\\}){1,}\\\\\\"\\s+?\\-f(?:.*\\)){1,}.*\\"")
